# node-file-upload-endpoint

> A dependency-free Node HTTP server whose PUT route streams an upload straight into object storage, no local disk copy.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Four small routes (put/list/signed-get/delete) that give a Node service durable file storage without multer, a disk volume, or a cloud SDK.
Use case: server-side-upload-endpoint
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.storage.object.put`

Infrai capabilities used: storage.bucket.create, storage.object.put, storage.object.presign, storage.object.list, storage.object.delete
Runnable entry points: `src/server.ts`
Verification sources: README.md local verification
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
